content:
“The Tonight Show” aired footage of multiple portable toilets being blown across the ground by fierce nor’easter winds outside MetLife Stadium this weekend in New Jersey.

Then he zinged: “Sorry, actually, turns out that was just Trump sneaking onto his plane back to Washington.”

The gag referenced the moment in July when Trump, amid an Iranian threat to his safety, snuck out of Air Force One inside a catering truck.

“Sorry, excuse me, pardon me, excuse me, pardon me, hello ...” Fallon imagined the president saying as the portable toilets tumbled across the screen.
